mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy stance, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS change and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point increase in the unemployment rate over the past three months indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending power and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises by >0.5pp in 3 months, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the joint effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in regression).

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%), a federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 for two consecutive months indicates robust manufacturing activity, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where INDPRO > 105.0 for two consecutive months, or the correlation is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 2.0% annualized over the past quarter signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of quarters where GDPC1 < 2.0% (annualized), or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 50,000 monthly additions signals labor market weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS < 50,000, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) and declining housing starts (HOUST < 1400 thousand units) signal a stagflationary demand shock, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced purchasing power and investment uncertainty.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and HOUST < 1400, or the joint effect is not significant (p > 0.05).
